object.title: The game
object.text:
AGBE is a free life simulation game set in Togo, in Lomé. It is played in a browser or as an installed app (phone, tablet, computer).

These terms apply to anyone who uses AGBE, as a guest or with an account.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.text: For any question about AGBE, contact us by e-mail:

access.title: Access to the game and account
access.text:
AGBE is for adults only: your date of birth is asked to check it.

You can play as a guest, without an account, then create your account to keep your game. An account is created with an e-mail address and a phone number, or with Google.

You are responsible for your account: keep your password secret and never give it to anyone, not even someone claiming to be the AGBE team. Two-factor authentication is available in Settings.

money.title: In-game money and purchases
money.text:
The game’s FCFA, coins and goods are virtual: they have no real value and cannot be withdrawn, exchanged or converted into real money.

Some content (coins, Premium perks) can be bought with real money through a payment operator. The price is shown before you pay, and the purchase is credited once the operator confirms the payment. Your payment details are handled by the operator: AGBE does not receive or keep them.

Virtual content that has been bought and used is not refundable, except in case of an error on our side or where the law requires it. If something goes wrong, contact us with your purchase reference.

conduct.title: Good conduct
conduct.text:
Chat and exchanges between players must stay respectful. The following are forbidden: insults, harassment, hateful or discriminatory remarks, illegal or sexual content, scams, impersonation and unauthorised advertising.

Cheating is also forbidden: using automated programs, deliberately exploiting a bug or trying to access what is not yours.

You can report a message from the chat. We may hide a message, and suspend or delete an account that breaks these rules.

info.title: Public services: simplified information
info.text:
AGBE introduces some Togolese public services (OTR, CNSS, AMU, CFE, land title) and everyday procedures. The game simplifies them: amounts, rates, delays and steps may differ from reality and change over time.

What the game shows is neither legal, tax nor financial advice, nor official information. For a real procedure, check with the organisation concerned.

ads.title: Advertising, music and links
ads.text:
The game may show advertising from partners, presented as such.

Artists’ music is offered as previews and links to the official platforms; the works belong to their authors. External sites that AGBE links to are the responsibility of their publishers.

data.title: Your personal data
data.text:
We use: your username, e-mail address, phone number, date of birth, language and, if you sign in with Google, your Google identifier; your game data; and your IP address and sign-in history, for security and fraud prevention.

This data is used only to run the game, secure your account and send you useful messages (such as a password reset). It is not sold. Your password is stored in an encrypted form that cannot be read back.

Cookies: AGBE only uses a session cookie to keep you signed in (and temporary cookies during a Google sign-in). Your preferences (language, graphics quality) stay on your device. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

Your rights: from Settings, you can export your data and delete your account. The account is then closed at once: nobody can sign in to it any more and your name no longer appears in the game. For security and fraud prevention (abuse, payment dispute, request from the authorities), your username, your character’s name, your phone, your e-mail, your Google ID, your date of birth and your IP addresses are kept separately, accessible only to the AGBE team, for one year after the deletion, then erased automatically — unless an investigation is under way. Accounting data (payments) is kept as long as the law requires. For any other request, contact us.

changes.title: Changes to the game and to these terms
changes.text:
The game evolves: features may be added, changed or removed, and the service may be interrupted for maintenance. We do our best to keep it available, without being able to guarantee it at all times.

These terms may be updated; the date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page.

howto.title: How to play AGBE
howto.intro: Everything you need to start your life in Lomé: your first steps, your goals, then the complete game guide.

start.title: Start your game
start.text: Tap “Play for free”. You can play right away as a guest, without an account, or create your account with your e-mail or Google to find your game on all your devices. AGBE is for adults only.

character.title: Create your character
character.text: Choose their name, their profile (Togolese from home, from the diaspora or a foreigner), their region and their starting condition: well-off, middle or poor, or let fate decide. Then choose their look: hairstyle, outfit, fabric…

job.title: Find a job
job.text: A short guided tour shows you the game screen. Then open the Phone and the Work app: pick a job that needs no diploma (car washer, delivery rider, seller…), go there during opening hours and start a shift to get paid.

needs.title: Keep your gauges green
needs.text: Hunger, energy, hygiene, health, mood and respect drop over time. Eat, sleep, wash and get treated: if a gauge falls too low, you can no longer work.

bills.title: Pay your rent and bills
bills.text: Every month, pay your rent, electricity and water in the “Rent and bills” app. Paying late is expensive, and after three months of unpaid rent you are evicted.

grow.title: Grow your life
grow.text: Save, go back to school, register your company at the CFE, buy land and build your house. There is no ending: you succeed in Lomé by reaching your goals.

howto.goalsText: There is no ending in AGBE: you succeed in Lomé by reaching these goals, which you also find in the “How to play” app on the in-game phone.

industry.title: 🏭 Industry: factories, free zones, farms and livestock
industry.text: In the Company app, Factories and sites tab, buy a factory (soap, brewery, cement, refinery…), a free-zone plot, a large plantation or a livestock farm, on behalf of one of your registered companies (Company app: CFE, RCCM/NIF, CNSS); its turnover is declared with the company at the OTR and its player staff are the company’s employees. After a start-up period, the site produces a result every game day: depending on staff, good and bad days and incidents (breakdown, drought, disease), minus wages and fixed costs, you can win or lose: hire non-player staff (just a number) or post job offers that other players accept in the Work app; you pay their wages every month, with CNSS, AMU and income tax, as in a company. OTR tax (5% of turnover) is declared and paid at the OTR: if late, penalties apply and collecting is blocked. You can bring a big investor into the capital (they pay at once and take their share of profits) or resell the site to another player. On weak-demand days part of the output stays unsold (overproduction): clear it at a discount, or keep it hoping for a better season, knowing it loses value (fast for fresh produce). Water and power cost a share of output: a borehole cuts mains water (but its pump uses electricity), a solar installation cuts electricity and is expensive. Both need regular servicing, at varying prices, and can break down: they then need repairing.

fuel.title: ⛽ Fuel and running dry
fuel.text: Your motorbike or car uses fuel. Fill up at a petrol station at the pump price. Far from a station or out of fuel, open the Garage app: you can have fuel delivered where you are, at a higher price (marked-up litre plus a delivery fee).

start.title: 🚀 Getting started
start.text: You start a life in Lomé. Watch your gauges, find a job, pay your rent and grow your money. Everything happens on the map and your phone.

needs.title: ❤️ Your gauges
needs.text: Hunger, energy, hygiene, health, morale and respect drop over time. Eat, sleep, wash and get care: when they are too low you cannot work.

money.title: 💰 Money
money.text: Everything is in FCFA. Your money is in the Wallet app. Put some aside in Savings to earn interest every day.

work.title: 💼 Working
work.text: Go to your workplace during opening hours and start a service: each accepted customer pays you. You see your job being done: at the shop counter the customer comes to you, at the car wash cars arrive, get washed and leave, and the delivery rider speeds off by motorbike to pick up and drop parcels, then returns to the post at the end of the service. You can resign from a job in the Offers tab of the Work app and apply elsewhere. Evening classes (School app) unlock better jobs.

map.title: 🗺️ Greater Lomé
map.text: The map goes beyond the city: to the north, the N1 runs through the Davié toll to Tsévié, with the turn-off to Kpalimé; to the north-west, the road leaves the Agoè interchange for the Légbassito roundabout and market, then Apessito on the Mission-Tové road, and Sogbossito. Land zones for sale are there too. Drag and zoom the map to explore them.

health.title: 🏥 Getting care
health.text: At the CHU, a consultation plays out on screen: the doctor examines you, then hands you your results and prescription. If your health drops too low, you go to intensive care: you lie in a hospital ward bed while the doctor and nurse do their rounds, and you get up once you have recovered.

move.title: 🛵 Getting around
move.text: Walking is free but slow; zem, taxi and bus cost according to distance. Tap a place on the map or use the Ride app.

home.title: 🏠 Housing
home.text: You start as a tenant: single room, room-and-parlour or villa. Pay rent every month in the Rent app. When late, each month costs 10% more, the landlord comes knocking every week (respect and morale drop) and after 3 months you are evicted to a smaller home, or the street, with a debt. You can move (deposit + first month), buy your home or build on land bought in Real estate: no more rent. Tap “Decorate” at home to buy furniture, move it (arrows), rotate it, store it, give it to another player or sell it. The original bed, stove, table and TV are yours too. Your motorbike and car park on the parking space in front of your house.

study.title: 🎓 Studies and diplomas
study.text: You start with the bac: you can do every job that needs no diploma (shop clerk, rider, security guard…). To move up, open the Studies app: enrol at the University for a technical bac (G1, G2, G3, F1, F2, F3, F4, H), then a BTS (2 years, in every field), a bachelor’s (3 years), a master’s (2 years) and a doctorate, in one of 23 fields: computing, cybersecurity, data science and AI, telecoms and networks, accounting, banking and insurance, sales, law, human resources, journalism, health, pharmacy, education, agronomy, hospitality and tourism, transport and logistics, mechanics, construction, architecture, electricity, environment, fashion or hairdressing. Each year: pay enrolment, follow sessions from your phone (one per game day) then sit the exam; fail and you repeat the year. Each diploma opens better-paid jobs: developer, cybersecurity analyst, data scientist, nurse, doctor, lawyer, architect, engineer… The Work app sorts them into 22 families.

school.title: 🧑🏾‍🏫 Evening classes and lectures
school.text: In the School app: pick a course (bookkeeping, tailoring, motorbike mechanics, hospitality, hairdressing, driving school…), go there and pay the enrolment fee once. Then one session a day: be there on time (reminder 1 h before and at the start), at most 30 minutes late. You enter the classroom and follow the class until it ends: the teacher writes on the board, projects slides and explains. The question only comes at the end, and your answer validates the session. You can leave and come back before the end, your seat is kept. At the last session, your certificate unlocks jobs. Regularly in the evening, a public lecture takes place at the University: the whole city is told 1 h before. Entry is paid on the way in, and staying to the end earns respect and morale.

kitchen.title: 🍳 Cooking at home
kitchen.text: In the Kitchen app, do your shopping: ingredients at the market, SODIGAZ gas at the petrol station, stove and fridge at the supermarket. Head home, pick a recipe and start cooking: you see your character cook on the fire, then eat at the table. A home-cooked meal is cheaper than the restaurant and gives a little extra morale; leftovers keep (a day, four with a fridge) or can be frozen. Careful: fresh food spoils, and without fuel the stove won’t heat.

land.title: 🏞️ Land and real estate
land.text: In the Real estate app, pick a zone (countryside, in town or at sea 🌊) and buy quarter lots of 150 m²: the price per m² depends on location (centre, roadside, coast); sea plots have a very high fixed price. You can own at most 15 ha. Then do the paperwork in order: survey, favourable opinion, land title (fees and delays in game days). With the title you can build a house, or start an activity (garden, chicken house, brickworks, warehouse, cement plant) that pays you every day during its lifespan. You are blue on the map, other players have other colours, and a pennant marks each business. Zones grow as lots sell. You can resell a titled plot to another player at the price you set (at most 5 times its value): the buyer pays 5% duties and receives the title and the business. Collect your income before selling, and you can’t sell the house you live in. For a large site, join neighbouring plots that touch (the “Join” button): 2 lots for a cement plant (1,200 m²), 4 for a refinery (2,400 m²).

company.title: 🏢 Starting a business
company.text: When you create it, first choose its field from among 27 (construction, health, accounting, computing, trade…): each has its own revenue, cost and shift length, shown before you choose. Then register it at the CFE, hire, declare your employees to the CNSS and pay the OTR on time. You can run up to 3 businesses, pick the current one, sell it (the price depends on its profit and staff) or close it, once wages are paid and your tax return is filed. Each employee sells for you, even when you are offline: part of the profit lands in your wallet for every shift that passes.

tenders.title: 🏛️ Public tenders
tenders.text: In the Public tenders app, the State (or a company) posts projects by field. If your business is registered in that field, you can apply: propose your price and your deadline. The real cost to complete the project is shown before you apply, so you know if it is worth it. If you are picked, you must really work on the project (the “Advance” button, like a shift) until it is finished; you are then paid the price you proposed. A tender can cover several domains at once (for example a turnkey school: construction, architecture and electrical work): any business in one of those domains can apply.

grow.title: 📈 Growing your money
grow.text: Port trading, stocks, farming seasons and side businesses: every investment carries risk. Don’t put everything in one place. Trade: make the trip (buy at the port, sell on site) for the best gain, capped at 38%; from your phone, buying costs 5% more and selling pays less. Check the estimated gain before selling. Stock market: banks, telecoms and Gozem have shares; you are alerted when a share is low (good time to buy) or has gained value (time to sell).

safety.title: 🛡️ Safety
safety.text: Never share your password or code. Turn on two-factor authentication in Settings.

win.title: 🏆 How do I win?
win.text: AGBE is a life simulation: there is no “end”. You win by succeeding in life in Lomé: a steady job, bills paid, respect, a business, your own home and your first million FCFA. Track your goals at the top of this page. If life goes badly, you can start over from Settings.

controls.title: 🎮 Controls
controls.text: In the street: joystick (or arrow / WASD keys) to walk, drag to turn the camera, mouse wheel or two fingers to zoom. On the map: drag to move around, rotate it with two fingers (mouse: right-click or Shift + drag, or the ⟲ 🧭 ⟳ buttons, the compass puts north back up) and tap a place or building to see its card and go there. At the bottom: Home, Map and Phone. At home and inside places, drag to rotate the room and pinch or scroll to zoom. To go in somewhere, walk up to its entrance; to leave, walk to the door (the green doormat).

bills.title: ⚡ Bills
bills.text: Every month: electricity (CEET), water (TdE) and, if you want, wifi. Pay them in “Rent and bills”. Bills follow your use: a small subscription by housing, plus what you consume, in tranches (the first kWh and m³ are the cheapest). Electricity depends on the appliances installed (fridge, freezer, TV, fan…) and on electric hob cooking; solar panels reduce it. Water depends on household needs, your showers and your cooking. The breakdown is shown before you pay. Without power you sleep badly, without water no shower.

bank.title: 🏦 Banks
bank.text: Visit a branch (BOA, Orabank, Ecobank, NSIA, IB Bank, FUCEC) to open a savings account or a fixed-term deposit: the longer the term, the higher the rate. You can also borrow money (a cap set by the game): it is credited to your account right away. Repayment happens on its own, through instalments taken from your balance, or you can repay early yourself whenever you like. If your balance is too low on an instalment date, a late penalty is added, but nothing gets blocked: it catches up at the next possible payment. Only one loan at a time. Matured term deposits and the income from your investments are paid into your wallet automatically: no need to visit a branch.

guest.title: 👤 Playing without an account
guest.text: As a guest the whole game is open: live, work, bank, invest, run a business. Only real-money top-ups, ads, sea plots, buying land and money transfers need an account: create it in Settings, your game is kept.

zem.title: 🛵 Zém (moto-taxi) driver
zem.text: Go to the Gozem station (Assigamé), pick the zem driver job and start a service: you must first choose your motorbike. The Gozem bike is rented per session, upkeep included. With your own bike you pay nothing but it uses fuel and wears (refuel and service it in Garage). Entrusted bike: you sign a contract with an owner at the Gozem station and pay a fixed amount each session; you can end the contract whenever you want. You can change job whenever you like: at the job limit a pay-per-task job is replaced, and you can resign from a salaried job in the Offers tab of the Work app to apply elsewhere. During a ride your bike obeys the lights, keeps its distance and stops on the road near the place: the customer gets off and walks to the entrance. Amounts are shown before you choose.

worship.title: 🙏 Pray and reflect
worship.text: At the Sacred Heart Cathedral and the Lomé Central Mosque, step inside to see the interior. Pray in silence: you are alone in the hall. Attend Mass or the Friday prayer: worshippers take their places and the service unfolds with you. Make an offering or give alms: you stand up, slip your coin into the box (and light a candle at church). It lifts your morale and respect.

account.title: 🔑 Sign in with Google
account.text: When signing up you can choose “Continue with Google”: your address is already verified, so only a username, your phone number and your birth date are left (AGBE is for adults). If an AGBE account already uses that address, enter its password once to link it to Google. You can always sign in with your email and password too.

respect.title: ⭐ Earning respect
respect.text: Respect shows how far you have come in Lomé. Biggest gains: build your house on your titled land (Real estate) and move in (+20), buy your home (+15), buy a used car at the port (+10), finish a course (+5, plus +1 per right answer). Every day: perfume at the supermarket (+5), wax print, jewellery or a tailored shirt at Assigamé market (+4), a night out in Déckon, glasses at the CHU, a lecture at the University or second-hand clothes in Adidogomé (+3), agbadja at the Bè maquis, a tour of Akodessewa or the dentist (+2). Small things: pay your rent on time (+1 a month), serve a customer at work (+1), study for free at the University library (+1), a photo at the Monument or a vaccine (+1). Careful: late rent costs 2 respect a week, an eviction 15.

vip.title: 🏢 VIP spaces and brands
vip.text: On the map and in the street, “VIP SPACE” beacons mark free spots reserved for brands in three tiers: Bronze, Silver or Gold. Tap one to see the tier, its indicative price (FCFA, euros and dollars) and send your request: the team reviews it and answers on WhatsApp. Once the spot is assigned, the brand’s building appears with its logo: a clinic heals you, a restaurant feeds you, a shop sells its items, a station refuels you, and you can work there.

currency.title: 💱 Display currency
currency.text: At sign-up, or in Settings, choose to show amounts in FCFA, euros or dollars. Only the display is converted (approximately, at the rate set by the team): your balance, prices and payments stay in FCFA.

clothes.title: 👗 Getting dressed
clothes.text: Buy your clothes in a fashion shop (Grand Market, Nyékonakpoè, Bè, Adidogomé) with the Clothes app: tops, bottoms, dresses and shoes, in men’s, women’s or unisex cuts. You choose your outfit at home: before leaving, tap “Change outfit before leaving” on your destination card, pick a top and a bottom (or a dress) and shoes, then wear it. You can also rent your own clothing shop: buy stock wholesale, set your prices and sell to other players. Your clothing shop is also a business: neighbourhood customers buy from it on their own according to your prices (dear = few sales), even when you are offline, which pays the rent and leaves a profit. You can close it at any time: unsold stock is bought back and part of the unused rent is refunded.

sea.title: 🌊 Sea plots
sea.text: Left of the port, past the advertising squares, plots are sold on the water: whole lots, halves, thirds or quarters, as on land, but at a much higher fixed price (120,000 to 200,000 FCFA per m², double or triple the dearest city land). You recognise them by the 🌊 in the Real estate app and by their wooden pier on the map, ringed with rocks. A road on the water, continued by the west corniche, links them to the city; the big seafront plot near the beach is the closest one to town. Don’t confuse them with the blue advertising squares, which are rented by the week.

weather.title: ⛅ The weather
weather.text: It rains from time to time, mostly in the long rainy season (April to July) and the short one (September to November); big storms bring lightning. The Weather app and the phone home screen show the weather right now (rain, day, night), the temperature and when the rain stops, always matching the city.

trade.title: 🛒 Trade
trade.text: The Trade app has two tabs: “Buy” (the catalogue: buy here or remotely) and “My stock” (what you bought). In My stock, resell each item on the spot, where the price is best, or remotely from the phone; the estimated gain or loss is shown before you confirm. The market only absorbs a limited amount a day: between 5 and 25 units of each item, a number that changes every day.

decor.title: 🛋️ Decorate your home
decor.text: At home, tap “Decorate”. Shop: buy a piece, it lands on a free spot. My furniture: pick one, move it with the arrows (green = free spot, red = blocked), rotate it, then confirm. You can also store it, give it to another player (by username) or sell it. The more comfortable furniture you own, the higher your standing (modest, comfortable, luxurious).

notifs.title: 🔔 Notifications
notifs.text: Your phone shows “You have N notifications”: tap it to open the page. Alerts to settle (rent, bills, health…) come first, recent notifications below; each opens the related app.

traffic.title: 🚦 Traffic
traffic.text: Cars, buses, trucks and zémidjans obey traffic lights and keep their distance. Semi-trailers and tankers run on the bypasses, near the interchanges, and on the road to Davié and Tsévié. When the ambulance passes with its siren on, they stop and pull over. If you have a motorbike or a car, park it in the parking space in front of your house. While you are on duty you don’t walk into a venue just by stopping at its entrance.
